claims.claim: Mandatory pension contributions from January 2017: 18.5% of salary in total, of which 6.0% is the employee's and the remaining 12.5% the employer's, split as 6.5% employer tagmulim and 6% employer severance. 8.33% is NOT the statutory severance rate: it is the 1/12 rate that fully funds the statutory one-month-per-year and is what a full Section 14 (סעיף 14) release requires, giving an employer side of 14.83% and a total of 20.83%. At the 6% minimum the severance component covers about 72% of the statutory figure, so a completion payment is owed.

claims.note: The 72% figure is arithmetic: 6 divided by 8.33 is about 0.72.

claims.claim: Section 45a (סעיף 45א) of the Income Tax Ordinance grants a 35% income-tax credit on the employee's pension contribution up to 7% of salary, with an annual ceiling of about NIS 8,148 (8,148 ש"ח) in 2026.

claims.claim: Severance is one month's salary per year of employment after at least 1 year. Where the deposit is at the 6% minimum the fund covers only about 72% of the statutory figure and a completion payment (hashlamat pitzuyim) is owed.
claims.raw_snippet: החל משנת 2017 אחוזי ההפרשה המינימאליים קבועים ועומדים על 18.5% בצו הרחבה לפנסיית חובה

claims.claim: Notice period: 1 day per month in the first 6 months; 6 days plus 2.5 days per month after the 6th month between 6-12 months; 1 full month after 1 year. Monthly salaried 12-month figure equals 21 days.
